title: QaVerdict
description: The evaluator persona's structured merge verdict. Posted as a PR comment: a human-readable summary above, this JSON in a fenced ```json block below. scripts/qa-merge.sh refuses to merge without a valid one matching the PR's current head SHA. Replaces the free-form magic-phrase sign-off: deterministic-gate fields are filled from CI output (the persona does not get to type "tests pass"), and the verdict is computed — any deterministic-gate fail means blocked, regardless of judgment.

pr.description: PR number this verdict applies to.

author_persona.description: Persona slug that authored the PR (inferred from branch prefix). Must NOT equal the evaluator persona — no self-merge, structurally.

head_sha.description: The exact commit this verdict evaluated. qa-merge.sh rejects the verdict if the PR head has moved — a stale green does not count.

persona.description: The evaluator persona slug (role: evaluator in graph.yaml).

judge_model_family.description: Model family of the rung-3 LLM judge, if one ran. Must differ from the authoring model's family — self-preference bias is measured, not hypothetical.

name.description: Gate name from graph.yaml, or acceptance_criteria_review for the rung-3 judge.

reason.description: REQUIRED when status is deferred. Deferral is not a free action.

followup.description: Ticket ID tracking the deferred check. Required for deferred unless reason establishes not-applicability.

rung.description: 1 = deterministic test/build, 2 = policy lint, 3 = LLM judge. Rung 3 never gates alone.

verdict.description: Computed, not chosen: any rung-1/rung-2 fail ⇒ blocked, regardless of rung 3.
